keyEnergy2026.title: Afore Italia at Key Energy 2026
keyEnergy2026.excerpt: Afore Italia confirms its participation in the next edition of Key Energy 2026, the reference event for the renewable energy sector. Visit us at Booth D5-130 with our photovoltaic solutions.
keyEnergy2026.body:
What is Key Energy?

Key Energy is Italy's leading trade fair dedicated to renewable energy, energy efficiency and sustainability. Organized by Italian Exhibition Group (IEG) at Rimini Fiera, the event takes place every year and is a key reference for operators, installers, manufacturers and professionals in the photovoltaic and energy sector.

The fair covers all aspects of the energy transition: solar photovoltaics, wind power, energy storage, e-mobility, building efficiency and smart city technologies. Thousands of visitors and hundreds of exhibitors participate to showcase the latest innovations, forge partnerships and stay up to date on market trends.

Afore Italia at Key Energy 2026

Afore Italia confirms its participation in the next edition of Key Energy 2026. Visit us at Booth D5-130 with our photovoltaic solutions: string inverters, hybrids, storage batteries and All-in-One systems. Come discover the 2026 novelties, attend live demos and meet our technical team.

spazio900.title: Spazio 900: presentation of the new Afore product
spazio900.excerpt: Afore Italia presents Spazio 900, the new photovoltaic solution for residential and commercial applications. Discover the features and highlights of the product launch.
spazio900.body:
Afore Italia presented Spazio 900 during an event dedicated to partners and installers. The new solution combines compact design, high performance and ease of installation for the residential and commercial photovoltaic market.

Spazio 900 represents a further step in Afore innovation, with state-of-the-art technologies to maximize self-consumption and system efficiency. The presentation covered technical details, applications and configuration options.
